basic_info.description: Detached Glen Park SFH under $1Mno HOA, city views, garage, 1K sq ft expansion. Charming 1BR/1BA detached home in the heart of Glen Park with no HOA fees, wrap-around deck, bonus WFH room, and thoughtfully designed plans for 1,000 sq ft expansion. High ceilings and tall windows fill the open Great Room with natural light, highlighting hardwood floors and creating an airy, welcoming space. The kitchen opens to the living area for easy entertaining. Enjoy city views from the bedroom and unwind in the marble-tiled bath. The bonus room is ideal for an office, den, or guest space.  Perfect for first-time buyers or developers, this home includes a 1-car garage with additional spaceperfect for storage, a workshop, or even a home gym. Just an 8-minute walk to Glen Park BART for an easy commute. Located on a peaceful street near village shops and local favorites like Destination Baking Company and Canyon Market. Glen Canyon Park's trails, tennis courts, and climbing wall are nearby, with quick access to Noe Valley, Bernal Heights, and I-280. A rare SF opportunity offering location, lifestyle, and long-term potential.
